name: Dramatic Deep Dive
description: Full-Kanto Deep Dive preview: every detected Kanto water cell gets a coherent generated seabed, seamless underwater route connections, cave/harbor portals, biome-aware geology and lighting, living Pokedex-scaled Pokemon, salvage, Wilds/Sky compatibility and HM08 DIVE. Surface DIVE masking is intentionally disabled because all water is diveable.
